added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
About Latent

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform. Our clinical AI streamlines prior authorizations, appeals, and 340B compliance, so patients start therapy faster and care teams spend less time on paperwork.

We raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital, with General Catalyst, McKesson Ventures, Conviction, and Y Combinator. 60+ health systems run on Latent, including Yale New Haven, Mount Sinai, UCSF, and Ochsner. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and build products that directly improve patient care.

The Role

As a Product Manager at Latent, you will own critical product initiatives from strategy through execution. Working closely with engineering, design, GTM, and customers, you'll identify the highest-impact problems in healthcare operations and deliver scalable solutions for large health systems.

We move fast, operate with high ownership, and build products that directly improve patient care. We're looking for a Product Manager to define and build the next generation of clinical AI products powering healthcare.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Ownership

Define product strategy and roadmap aligned with company goals and customer needs
Translate ambiguous problems into clear product plans, requirements, and deliverables
Own product outcomes and metrics for the areas of the platform you lead

Customer Insight & Discovery

Work directly with healthcare customers to understand clinical workflows and operational challenges
Conduct user interviews and synthesize feedback into actionable product insights
Balance customer input with long-term vision and strategic priorities

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with engineering, design, and commercial teams to build and ship products quickly
Write clear product specs and make trade-offs to unblock development
Drive projects from concept through launch and iteration

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Define success metrics and run experiments to measure product performance
Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve features and workflows

What We're Looking For

Product Experience: 5+ years in product management (or equivalent in engineering, product strategy, or a related field) building enterprise SaaS, AI/automation, or complex workflow products
End-to-End Ownership: Track record of taking a product area from strategy and discovery through launch and measurable outcomes. Experience 0→1 opportunities especially
Customer Obsession: Skilled at embedding with users, running discovery, and translating insights into practical solutions
Collaboration: Thrives in cross-functional environments; builds strong working relationships across engineering, design, GTM, and leadership
Communication: Communicates complex problems and trade-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences
Technical Fluency: Comfortable digging in with engineering on APIs, integrations, system design, and AI-powered workflows
Startup Mindset: Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments — adaptable, high-ownership, and able to maintain momentum through change

Nice to Have

Experience with AI-powered or data-driven products
Familiarity with healthcare, EHRs, or clinical systems
Background in startups or high-growth environments
Experience building products for operational or workflow-driven use cases
0-to-1 product development experience
Comfort with data and developer tooling: SQL, AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor), and design tools (e.g., FigmaMake)

Why Join Latent

Backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator
Work alongside a high-caliber team building products our healthcare partners love
Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare
Real ownership and visibility
High-impact role on a small, fast-growing team

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

Equity Derivatives Product Control

Corporate Title
: Vice President

Finance

New York, NY

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $145K and $175K/year * (see below footnote for additional compensation and benefits information).

Company Overview

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

Aon’s Benefit Index®, Nomura’s benefits rank #1
amongst our competitors

Department Overview

Nomura's Finance department manages the company's financial operations and provides financial guidance to support business decision-making. The team collaborates with senior leadership, business units, and stakeholders to develop effective financial strategies, providing guidance on financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis to align financial operations with business objectives. Nomura's Finance team specializes in financial reporting, accounting, tax, treasury, and capital management, known for providing exceptional service to clients. With a strong track record and commitment to innovation and global reach, Nomura's Finance department is well-positioned to continue driving growth and success in the financial industry.

Role Description

This role supports the Equity Derivatives trading desk with a primary focus on Structured Products and Exotic Derivatives, including but not limited to auto callables, barrier options, variance/volatility swaps, digital/binary options, and structured financing transactions. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of Equity Options, Futures, Swaps, and complex path-dependent and multi-asset derivatives. The successful Product Controller will be highly attentive to detail and risk, demonstrate strong commercial awareness of exotic Greeks and model risk, and uphold the importance of a robust control environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Daily P&L Reporting & Analysis: Flash to Actual analysis, Front-to-Back reconciliations, detailed P&L attribution (including vega, correlation, skew, dividend, and higher-order Greek decomposition for exotic books), verification of manual adjustments, and Balance Sheet Attestation.
Stakeholder Engagement: Close interaction with the trading desk, Treasury, Middle Office/Ops, IT, Market Risk, Financial Reporting, Regulatory, and IPV teams to resolve booking, valuation, and financial resource usage-related issues — with particular focus on complex lifecycle events (barriers, autocall triggers, put financing transactions)
Process Improvement: Input into the development of tactical and strategic process improvement projects, including automation of exotic P&L explain workflows, as well as testing and implementation of end-state solutions
Funding & Financing: Understanding daily summary of funding charges, including day-over-day variance analysis and the impact of structured product collateral/margin dynamics.
Manual Adjustments: Understanding, challenge, and motivation to resolve all manual adjustments, including model reserves, Day 1 P&L, and valuation adjustments specific to illiquid exotics
Team Leadership: Managing junior team members both onshore and offshore; mentoring on exotic product knowledge and control best practices.
Deal Review & Structuring Support: Deal review analysis and return, as well as review of deal reviews performed by the offshore team
Controls & KRIs: Ensuring proper controls are in place as measured by KRI metrics, with specific attention to model risk, market data quality, and lifecycle event processing for exotic structures
Month-End Close: Closing of the firm's books and records, including required manual journal entries and Balance Sheet substantiation; reconciliation of monthly FO P&L to General Ledger; completion of various financial reporting schedules; reserve and Day 1 P&L amortization reviews

Skills, Experience, Qualifications And Knowledge Required

At least 8–10 years of Equities-focused Product Control experience, with a minimum of 4–5 years covering Structured Products and/or Exotic Derivatives (autocallables, barriers, variance swaps, correlation products, bespoke payoffs)
Strong understanding of exotic derivative pricing models, Greeks (including cross-Greeks for multi-asset products), and associated model risk
Familiarity with lifecycle events unique to structured/exotic products (barrier breaches, autocall observations, early termination, dividend adjustments)
BS/BA in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a quantitative discipline; CFA, CPA, or FRM designation preferred
Proven ability to manage and develop junior staff in a global team structure
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment with strong prioritization skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex product P&L drivers to senior stakeholders
Team player, proactive, self-starter who can operate dynamically while maintaining rigorous attention to detail

Nomura Leadership Behaviours

Explore Insights & Vision: Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.
Making Strategic Decisions: Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.
Inspire Entrepreneurship in People: Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.
Elevate Organizational Capability: Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.
Inclusion: Foster a culture of inclusion and psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).
base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, corporate and functional title and duties, job-related knowledge and advanced degrees, skills, and experience. 26WD101063,
Director, Product Management, Platform Trust

Position Overview

This role is accountable for defining what trusted capabilities Autodesk customers need and why they matter, partnering with product and platform organizations that determine how those capabilities are delivered. We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy for Trusted experiences across Autodesk's platform ecosystem. Trust is foundational to every customer experience and every AI-powered workflow we deliver. This role will define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the trust capabilities customers expect and partner with product and platform teams to ensure these capabilities are delivered consistently across Autodesk products. Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer you will partner across Autodesk to influence platform investments and product strategy. You will translate evolving customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and competitive trends into platform investments that strengthen Autodesk's differentiation. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring exceptional influence, strategic thinking, and execution across a global organization.

We are open to remote candidates based in the United States and Canada.

Responsibilities

Define the long-term product vision and strategy for Trust and Trusted AI capabilities across Autodesk's platform ecosystem
Partner with Platform Product Managers and Engineering leaders to prioritize customer-facing trust capabilities that can be leveraged consistently across Autodesk products
Develop business cases and product strategies informed by customer research, market trends, competitive analysis, technology innovation and evolving regulatory requirements
Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership on trust priorities and roadmap investments
Continuously evaluate the evolving security, privacy, resilience, and AI landscape to identify strategic opportunities and emerging customer needs
Represent Autodesk's Trust strategy with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and industry forums

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of Product Management or Platform Product Management experience, including defining platform strategy across multiple products
Experience influencing product strategy across large, matrixed organizations without direct ownership of engineering teams
Strong understanding of enterprise customer expectations around security, privacy, resilience, and AI trust
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across technical and business organizations
Strong ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, technical complexity, and regulatory considerations
Experience developing product strategies informed by customer insights, competitive analysis, and data
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business strategies
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with experience defining success metrics and measuring product outcomes
Experience presenting strategy to executive leadership and engaging directly with enterprise customers
Experience working effectively across globally distributed teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building platform products for enterprise SaaS or cloud platforms
Knowledge of modern security architectures, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, privacy engineering, or AI governance frameworks
Experience working with AI/ML platform capabilities and responsible AI practices
Familiarity with industry security and privacy standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, GDPR, CCPA, or similar frameworks
MBA or technical degree
Experience working with platform adoption, developer experience, or shared services organizations

26WD101063,
Directeur de la gestion des produits, Confiance dans la plateforme

Aperçu du poste

Le titulaire de ce poste est chargé de définir les fonctionnalités fiables dont les clients d'Autodesk ont besoin et d'expliquer leur importance, en collaboration avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes qui déterminent la manière dont ces fonctionnalités sont mises en œuvre. Nous recherchons un directeur de la gestion des produits expérimenté pour diriger la stratégie produit relative aux expériences de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk. La confiance est le fondement de chaque expérience client et de chaque flux de travail basé sur l’IA que nous proposons. Le titulaire de ce poste définira la vision, la stratégie et les priorités concernant les fonctionnalités de confiance attendues par les clients et travaillera en partenariat avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes afin de garantir que ces fonctionnalités soient mises en œuvre de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk. Sous la responsabilité du directeur de la confiance (Chief Trust Officer), vous travaillerez en collaboration avec l’ensemble d’Autodesk pour orienter les investissements dans les plateformes et la stratégie produit. Vous traduirez l’évolution des attentes des clients, des exigences réglementaires et des tendances concurrentielles en investissements dans les plateformes qui renforceront la différenciation d’Autodesk. Il s’agit d’un poste de direction hautement collaboratif et transversal, exigeant une influence exceptionnelle, une réflexion stratégique et une capacité d’exécution au sein d’une organisation mondiale.

Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance provenant des États-Unis et du Canada.

Responsabilités

Définir la vision et la stratégie produit à long terme pour les fonctionnalités de confiance et d’IA de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk
Collaborer avec les chefs de produit des plateformes et les responsables de l’ingénierie afin de hiérarchiser les fonctionnalités de confiance destinées aux clients, pouvant être exploitées de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk
Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des stratégies produit fondées sur les études clients, les tendances du marché, l’analyse de la concurrence, l’innovation technologique et l’évolution des exigences réglementaires
Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Sécurité, Confidentialité, Juridique, Conformité, Réussite client et la direction générale concernant les priorités en matière de confiance et les investissements dans la feuille de route
Évaluer en permanence l’évolution du paysage de la sécurité, de la confidentialité, de la résilience et de l’IA afin d’identifier les opportunités stratégiques et les besoins émergents des clients
Représenter la stratégie de confiance d’Autodesk auprès des clients professionnels, des partenaires stratégiques et des forums sectoriels

Qualifications Minimales

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produit ou en gestion de produit de plateforme, y compris la définition d’une stratégie de plateforme couvrant plusieurs produits
Expérience dans l’orientation de la stratégie produit au sein de grandes organisations matricielles sans responsabilité directe sur les équipes d’ingénierie
Solide compréhension des attentes des clients d’entreprise en matière de sécurité, de confidentialité, de résilience et de confiance dans l’IA
Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes de la direction et à favoriser l’alignement entre les organisations techniques et commerciales
Grande capacité à concilier les besoins des clients, les priorités commerciales, la complexité technique et les considérations réglementaires
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies produit fondées sur les insights clients, l’analyse concurrentielle et les données
Excellentes compétences en communication et en narration, avec la capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en stratégies commerciales convaincantes
Solides compétences en analyse et en réflexion stratégique, avec une expérience dans la définition d’indicateurs de réussite et la mesure des résultats des produits
Expérience dans la présentation de stratégies à la direction et dans l’interaction directe avec les clients professionnels
Expérience de travail efficace au sein d’équipes réparties à l’échelle mondiale

Qualifications Souhaitées

Expérience dans le développement de produits de plateforme pour des plateformes SaaS ou cloud d’entreprise
Connaissance des architectures de sécurité modernes, des infrastructures cloud, des systèmes d’identité, de l’ingénierie de la confidentialité ou des cadres de gouvernance de l’IA
Expérience de l’utilisation des fonctionnalités des plateformes d’IA/ML et des pratiques d’IA responsable
Connaissance des normes sectorielles en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité, telles que ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, RGPD, CCPA ou des cadres similaires
MBA ou diplôme technique
Expérience dans le domaine de l’adoption de plateformes, de l’expérience développeur ou au sein d’organisations de services partagés

added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

ZoomInfo
is how businesses go to market (GTM) and we’re on a mission to modernize go-to-market for everyone. Powered by real-time data and insights, our unified GTM intelligence platform helps sales and marketing teams find, acquire, and grow customers. You will lead a team of talented designers, engineers, marketers, and analysts to help build the best product, enabling our customers to unlock insights, engage customers, and win faster.

We're seeking a Senior Product Manager
to lead the transformation of ZoomInfo's apps for the era of AI agents and generative AI. In this role, you'll reimagine how go-to-market teams—across sales, marketing, and customer success—discover, engage, and convert their target audiences by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to create intelligent, autonomous workflows that power the full revenue lifecycle.

Why ZoomInfo

Unmatched Data Moat: You’ll build AI on top of the biggest context graph in enterprise - 600+ million contacts, 100m+ companies, 1.5 billion signals. The kind of proprietary foundation that makes AI actually work at scale.
This Is the Bet: AI is not a side initiative here. It's central to the company's next chapter, with executive sponsorship, dedicated AI/ML engineering teams, and real investment behind it.
Ship Fast, Learn Fast: We operate with a builder's mentality — rapid experimentation, short feedback loops, and a culture that rewards velocity and iteration over perfection.
Greenfield Opportunity: You won't be maintaining legacy features. You'll be defining entirely new AI-native experiences for the GTM category, with the autonomy to shape what gets built and how.

What You'll Do

Own the AI Product Lifecycle: Drive AI-native products from ideation through launch and iteration, leveraging generative AI, autonomous agents, and LLMs.
Set Vision and Roadmap: Define a compelling vision for how AI agents will reshape GTM workflows and translate it into a strategic, aligned roadmap.
Engage Customers: Partner with sales, marketing, and CS users to identify where AI-driven automation delivers the most value.
Measure What Matters: Define and track AI-centric metrics—agent task completion, model accuracy, automation rates—and turn insights into action using tools like Amplitude and Tableau.
Champion the User: Ensure AI capabilities solve real user problems, not just showcase technical possibilities.
Lead Cross-Functionally: Rally engineers, AI/ML specialists, designers, and GTM teams to ship intelligent, best-in-class experiences.
Align Stakeholders: Communicate AI product strategy clearly and compellingly to executives and cross-functional partners through regular written updates.

What You’ll Bring

AI Builder at Heart: You don't just manage AI products — you build with them. You vibe code prototypes on weekends, tinker with the latest AI tools for fun, and have a graveyard of side projects to prove it. That hands-on instinct makes you a better PM and a more credible partner to engineering and design.
AI-Native Mindset: You've built products using LLMs, autonomous agents, and generative AI — and AI is woven into how you think, work, and solve problems. You stay current on emerging capabilities and know how to translate the latest AI advancements into real product value for users.
GTM Fluency: You know how sales, marketing, and customer success teams actually work — their workflows, tools, metrics, and pain points. You can walk into a room of revenue leaders and immediately earn credibility.
UX Obsession: You believe AI is only as good as the experience it enables. You have a sharp eye for design and a bias toward simplicity — making complex, intelligent capabilities feel effortless to the end user.

What Does Success Look Like

Ship AI-native GTM products: Build on ZoomInfo's context graph and agent platform that don't just keep pace with the competition — they redefine the category.
Change How People Work: The products you build make GTM professionals measurably more effective. Users don't just adopt them — they can't imagine going back.
Drive Revenue Impact: Your products aren't science projects. They generate real, measurable revenue growth — through new customer acquisition, expansion, and retention.

How We Work

Be Relentless. We will be relentless: when we deliver value to clients; when we compete; when we run into difficult problems. We will outpace and outcompete our competition. We are smart, clever, and resourceful in everything we do. Competing with us for the same customers will be a daunting experience.
Be Entrepreneurs. Entrepreneurs hustle, move fast, take ownership, they have autonomy, and make decisions. They are accountable, but they do not operate in fear, they aren’t afraid to fail. They are resilient, resourceful, and solutions-oriented - even when conditions say otherwise. We will entrust, and expect, our leadership and our teams to operate as entrepreneurs.
Be Experts. Winning for our customers requires that we understand them deeply. Winning for our business requires us to be experts in our domain areas. Great companies solve complex and costly problems for their customers - you can’t do this without being an expert in your customers’ day to day workflow. We will demand this level of customer and business expertise from everyone at the company.
Be Innovators. Innovating is who we are, it is how we have gotten here. But not just with our product and how we define what GTM means for the future. We innovate to be leaner and more efficient in the way we operate, we will find ways to drive outcomes no one thought were possible - from marketing and lead generation to legal, finance, and procurement. Through innovation, we will set a new standard for how great companies operate with discipline.
Be a Team. We can’t win if we act like a random assortment of siloed groups. We are one team, working together to win. We collaborate and lean in to help each other.

Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.

In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits here.

$171,430—$269,390 USD

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.

added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own and optimize the entire customer journey, ensuring customers easily discover the value of our platform from first engagement through long-term retention. You'll focus on reducing churn, improving signup-to-meeting-to-purchase conversion, and strengthening the overall product experience by working cross-functionally with product domain experts, marketing, sales, technical support, and customer success.
As part of both product experience and growth, you'll seed and shape innovation initiatives in areas such as AI, orchestration, and automation. You'll also take ownership of where the company focuses its product design projects, ensuring high impact, consistency, and usability across the platform and the experiences our customers rely on every day.

What You'll Own

Product Experience:
You'll map and optimize the buyer and user journey, from first awareness to adoption, purchase, and retention across the product portfolio. You'll identify friction points in product discovery and usability, ensuring customers can quickly see how our offerings solve their needs, and collaborate with marketing and sales to develop a strategic framework for product design that supports seamless continuity throughout the customer lifecycle.

Growth and Retention:
You'll work across departments to understand, analyze, and address the drivers of churn, and implement retention-focused improvements. You'll lead an effort to improve signup-to-first-meeting and lead-to-purchase conversion rates, collaborating with marketing and sales on onboarding, messaging, and trial experiences, and identify opportunities to increase customer engagement and expansion across the product portfolio.

Customer & Market Discovery:
You'll run continuous customer and market discovery to surface unmet needs and underserved workflows, drawing on customer interviews, win/loss reviews, and signals from sales and support. You'll build the business case for new products, including problem definition, market sizing, pricing and packaging hypotheses, and success metrics, and bring it to leadership for a build, buy, or partner decision.

Cross-Product Collaboration & Innovation:
You'll act as a strategic partner to domain product managers to ensure a cohesive product experience across the portfolio. You'll develop a strategy for, and foster project kickoffs in, innovation areas such as AI, orchestration, and automation, seeding ideas and setting vision while allowing autonomous teams to execute. You'll track emerging AI and automation capabilities and translate them into growth and product experience opportunities, and partner with engineering and design leadership on where to focus product design investment, balancing high-impact projects with consistency and usability across the platform.

What We're Looking For

Experience

6 or more years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer tools, ideally spanning growth, lifecycle, or platform experience work.
Demonstrated experience mapping and optimizing a multi-step customer journey, and using data to identify and close friction points in discovery, conversion, or retention.
Experience partnering with marketing, sales, and customer success/support to reduce churn and improve signup-to-purchase conversion.
Comfort setting direction for product design priorities and balancing consistency and usability across a multi-product platform.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to align domain product managers, engineering, and go-to-market teams around a shared roadmap.
Comfort working with data: defining metrics, interpreting funnel and cohort analytics, and using them to make prioritization calls.
Experience running customer and market discovery, including interviews and win/loss reviews, and building business cases for new products, including market sizing, pricing and packaging hypotheses, and success metrics, to support build, buy, or partner recommendations.

Preferred:

Familiarity with developer tooling ecosystems or CI/CD workflows.
Experience with virtualization, containerization, or Kubernetes-based orchestration platforms.
Experience seeding early-stage innovation initiatives in AI, orchestration, or automation, and setting vision for autonomous teams to execute.
Background in product-led growth, onboarding, or trial and self-serve conversion optimization.
Experience supporting enterprise, regulated, or security-conscious customers (finance, healthcare, government).

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Provider Products
added.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

The Provider Product team is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join a team that’s transforming how healthcare providers exchange information. You’re one to get excited when you see a challenge, you love trying new things, and learning about and improving your craft of product discovery and delivery is a constant interest.

As a Senior Product Manager in our Provider Experience Zone, you will own the roadmap for a suite of products that allow providers to request medical records for their patients to ensure seamless continuity of care and manage inbound requests for medical records from payer requestors.

What You Will Do

Becoming an expert in our provider user needs when requesting and managing patient record requests
Learning all about the core business of information exchange / release of information in healthcare
Diving deep into the current products for providers and Datvant’s ROI platform to understand key integrations
Partnering with our growth team and product marketing on go to market strategy for new products
Creating and socializing a clear product strategy and roadmap, that enables growth in market share

What You Need To Succeed

4-7+ years of product management experience, including demonstrated experience managing B2B products
Proven ability to translate complex stakeholder, user, operational, and technical needs into a clear product roadmap and strategy
Strong product instincts, with experience launching products balancing time to market and overall scope of initial offerings
Stakeholder management and communication skills; you can align diverse teams around priorities, tradeoffs, and a long-term strategy
Comfort operating in ambiguous, complex environments with many dependencies and high business impact
Analytical skills and ability to use data to understand user needs, diagnose platform issues, prioritize work, and measure outcomes
Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and business leaders to build and launch platform capabilities
Interest in the US healthcare provider / payer / services industry
